neighbours.label: the determiner after 'part of', 'a symptom of' or 'one sign of' that opens the larger whole something belongs to (predicting larger/broader/wider), as against 'part' for physical pieces and the same topics without the belonging frame
fire: The new bike lanes are part of a broader plan to cut traffic downtown.
Rising rents are a symptom of a wider housing crisis in the region.
The festival was part of a national celebration of the anniversary.
This merger is one sign of a growing trend toward consolidation.
The tax cut is part of an overall strategy to attract investors.
Her resignation was part of a larger shake-up at the ministry.
Burnout is often a symptom of a deeper imbalance at work.
The reforms formed part of the government's push to modernize schools.
quiet: The new bike lanes opened on Monday along a busy street downtown.
Rising rents forced many families to move out of the region.
We saved part of the cake from the celebration for the next day.
This merger was approved by a vote of the board on Friday.
The mechanic ordered a part for the old tractor from a dealer.
Her resignation letter arrived at the ministry on a rainy day.
Burnout makes it hard to sleep, eat and focus at work.
One of the pieces of the puzzle was missing from the box.
